name: roman_legionary_expanded
source: Authored from canon frames_96 poses; original Galahad pixels only.

background.notes: New frames are transparent 103×96 PNGs, same as the canon pack, so Hold the Line can load them later. GIFs composite onto opaque navy #0b1220 (GIF only has 1-bit transparency).

rules: Do not flip left/right cycles. Shield and spear stay in drawn hands.
Pixel-crisp: nearest-neighbor translations and overlays, no blur/resize.
Existing walk_* / attack / idle names are unchanged.

walk2_front.notes: 8-frame front walk. Even slots reuse canon walk_front_*; odd slots are whole-sprite in-betweens (no waist punch).

walk2_back.notes: 8-frame back walk. Whole-sprite in-betweens; not a flip of front.

walk2_left.notes: 8-frame left walk. Whole-sprite in-betweens from walk_left_*; never mirrored from right.

walk2_right.notes: 8-frame right walk. Whole-sprite in-betweens from walk_right_*; never mirrored from left.

run_front.notes: Front dash. 6 distinct whole-sprite poses (squash/shear/hop + dust). No torso/leg split.

run_back.notes: Back dash. 6 distinct whole-sprite poses from walk_back; no torso/leg split.

run_left.notes: Left dash. 6 distinct poses from walk_left. Spear/shield hands stay put.

run_right.notes: Right dash. 6 distinct poses from walk_right — not a flip of run_left.

turn.notes: Pivot using canon idle drawings (front→right→back→left). No mirrored 3/4.

block.notes: Front guard. Shield rises; hip filled; feet planted (no crouch-clip).

thrust.notes: Front spear thrust. Different silhouette from attack_21–24 (3/4 side).

cast.notes: Oath flash — magenta visor / Mark glow from the portrait lore.

kneel.notes: Brace / kneel. Feet planted (bottom-center anchor); torso compresses down.

wave.notes: Beckon. Spear grounded off, gauntlet waves.

jump.notes: Anticipation squat, tucked air (crest on-canvas), land. Feet planted on ground poses.
